name: Payment Status Tracker Report V 04
definition: The PaymentStatusTrackerReport message is sent by a tracking facility to relevant parties involved in the business transaction to report on the progress of one or more business transaction(s) and obtain transparency on the status.

GroupHeader.name: Group Header
GroupHeader.definition: Common business identification for the message.

TrackerStatusAndTransaction.name: Tracker Status And Transaction
TrackerStatusAndTransaction.definition: Transaction data and status information to be updated in the tracker.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
